name: linear-panel
description: A live Linear hierarchy beside the chat: every sub-issue under a parent, its status, progress and rollups; change status or comment from the panel, and Claude keeps Linear updated as it works.

mcpServer.title: Linear MCP server name
mcpServer.description: The connected Linear MCP server, as /mcp lists it (tools are mcp__<name>__*)

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh the hierarchy every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: Re-reads the whole tracked tree from Linear this often. 0 turns polling off (refresh with r or /linear refresh).

instructClaude.title: Have Claude keep Linear updated
instructClaude.description: Tells Claude which hierarchy is tracked and to move issues to In Progress / In Review as it works on them
